name: VCF Operations for Networks (formerly vRealize Network Insight)
description_en:
vRealize Network Insight is the historical name of the product subsequently called Aria Operations for Networks and now VCF Operations for Networks. Broadcom explicitly documents this naming sequence. Keep the installed version in view when following older articles: a familiar name does not establish current entitlement or compatibility.

The current product supports network planning and troubleshooting within VMware Cloud Foundation. It is a candidate for VCF network administrators investigating application communication and migration readiness, rather than a generic hosted website uptime service.
description_zh:
vRealize Network Insight 是历史名称，随后改称 Aria Operations for Networks，目前为 VCF Operations for Networks。Broadcom 明确记载了这一沿革。使用旧文章时需结合已安装版本；名称熟悉不代表当前授权或兼容性相同。

当前产品用于 VMware Cloud Foundation 内的网络规划和故障排查，适合调查应用通信和迁移准备情况的 VCF 网络管理员，不能按通用托管网站可用性服务来理解。

sections.title_en: Work from observed flows to an application map
sections.title_zh: 从观测流量建立应用通信图
sections.en:
The May 2026 datasheet describes application discovery, network assessment, VPC planning, and visibility across virtual and physical networking. Flow analytics uses IPFIX from supported sources such as VDS and Antrea. The resulting topology and metrics help investigate which workloads communicate and where a path deserves attention.

An illustrative evaluation starts with an application VM pair, verifies that the expected flow is visible, and compares its path and related host or edge metrics with the known environment. Before a VDS-to-VPC migration, inspect observed dependencies against the intended subnet plan. A discovered traffic relationship is evidence to review, not proof that every rarely used dependency was captured.
sections.zh:
2026 年 5 月资料说明了应用发现、网络评估、VPC 规划，以及虚拟和物理网络可视化。流量分析使用 VDS、Antrea 等受支持来源的 IPFIX，结合拓扑和指标调查哪些工作负载通信、哪些路径需要排查。

评估时可选一对应用虚拟机，确认预期流量可见，再将路径及相关主机或边缘指标与实际环境对照。VDS 迁往 VPC 前，应比较已观测依赖和目标子网规划。发现的通信关系仍需审核，不能证明所有低频依赖都已采集。

sections.title_en: Platform and collector have migration dependencies
sections.title_zh: 平台和采集器有迁移依赖
sections.en:
Broadcom documents a concrete failure mode: an existing collector pointed at a new platform may report CLI pairing success while never appearing in the platform interface. The prescribed resolution is to deploy a fresh collector and pair it using the new platform secret.

Check both the collector registration and actual incoming data. This is particularly important during platform migration, when a successful command alone can conceal a missing collection path. Data-source removal also has IPFIX configuration side effects described in the support article; migration needs the version-specific procedure, not a guessed sequence.
sections.zh:
Broadcom 记录了一种具体故障：旧采集器改指向新平台后，CLI 可能显示配对通过，但平台界面始终没有该采集器。官方处理方式是新部署采集器，并使用新平台生成的密钥配对。

需同时核对采集器登记和实际数据到达。平台迁移时尤其如此，命令成功本身可能掩盖采集链路缺失。支持文章还说明删除数据源会影响 IPFIX 配置，迁移应遵循对应版本流程，不能猜测操作顺序。

sections.title_en: Match upgrade guidance to the starting release
sections.title_zh: 按起始版本匹配升级路径
sections.en:
The official VCF 9.1 upgrade article treats Networks separately from the core stack. It says an Aria Operations for Networks installation must first reach 6.14 before the described import and upgrade workflow. It also discusses moving through VCF Operations fleet management.

Use that as a prerequisite signal, not an executable runbook for every patch. Inventory the installed build, verify its supported path and review the corresponding release documentation. This profile has not checked hardware sizing, every source-system version, or an actual upgrade result.
sections.zh:
官方 VCF 9.1 升级文章把 Networks 与核心栈分开处理，说明 Aria Operations for Networks 需先达到 6.14，才能采用文中导入和升级流程，并涉及 VCF Operations 的 fleet management。

这能说明前置条件，不能作为所有补丁版本的通用执行手册。应先登记已装 build，再确认受支持路径和对应发布文档。本文未检查硬件规格、全部数据源版本，也未实际升级。

sections.title_zh: 产品供应、报价与适用范围
sections.en:
The current datasheet places Operations for Networks within VMware Cloud Foundation and directs buyers to VMware or authorized resellers. No payable standalone price, free plan or current trial entitlement was established from the material read. Leave monetary fields unset and obtain a quote tied to the intended VCF environment, term and feature entitlements.

Shortlist it when VCF flow visibility and network operations are central to the task. For a small public endpoint monitor, the operational prerequisites may be disproportionate; that is an editorial fit judgment, not a tested ranking. Older cloud-product descriptions should not be carried forward as a current hosting or licensing promise.
sections.zh:
当前资料把 Operations for Networks 列为 VMware Cloud Foundation 的组成部分，并引导购买者联系 VMware 或授权经销商。本次资料未确认可支付的独立价格、免费套餐或当前试用权益，金额应留空，按目标 VCF 环境、期限和功能授权询价。

需要 VCF 流量可视化和网络运维时，可列入候选。若只是检查少量公网端点，其运维前提可能过重；这是编辑选型判断，并非实测排名。旧云产品介绍不能直接作为当前托管或许可承诺。
